name: comp-22
blurb: Email input with a spaced Send button.
description: An email input with an outline Button component separated by a gap. Uses standard Button component styling with outline variant.
use_when: You want a clearer visual separation between input and action, or the button needs to be independently styled.
avoid_when: Space is tight or you need a merged input+button look.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button is text-labeled. Button styling is handled by the Button component.
